msg: Hi there I will try to give you good advice on how to get the most mushrooms possibleEvery round there will be 2 pairs of gnomes that will come in colours for example:Yellow/Red, Blue/Purple, Green/Pink and Brown/Orange depending on which gnome you pick they will either take you to the bright or dark forestRed, Blue, Green and Orange will take you to the dark forestYellow, Purple, Pink and Brown will take you to the bright forestOvertime the mushrooms in either forest will change on how much mushrooms they have so focus on selecting the gnomes that will give you the most as possible, if they start to drop in numbers try selecting the other pairs colour to see if the amount has increased or decreasedI hope this advice will help you on your way to get the most amount of points as possible and I wish you good luck :)
